purpose: Prevent similarly numbered records from unrelated namespaces from being misidentified as missing continuity artifacts.
sources_inspected: File Library semantic and exact-string searches for M-004, M-005, and M-006

durable_memory.title: Identifier suffixes are not identities
durable_memory.rule: A numeric suffix match is insufficient to resolve a continuity identifier. Resolution requires namespace, owner, semantic role, temporal precedence, and immutable source agreement. Records such as V8-004, V9-004, V8-005, V9-005, V8-006, and V9-006 must not be promoted as M-004, M-005, or M-006 merely because the suffix matches.
durable_memory.graph_effect: Add namespace as a mandatory key on identifier nodes and classify suffix-only matches as collision candidates rather than provenance evidence.

observed: The canonical continuity queue names M-004, M-005, and M-006 as unresolved continuity identifiers.
File Library searches returned records with matching numeric suffixes in V8 and V9 proof-machine namespaces, not records assigned to the M continuity namespace.
The returned records concern mathematical benchmark items and do not contain continuity-mining ownership, provenance-gap semantics, or the missing artifact identifiers.
inferred: Loose semantic search can create false continuity by collapsing distinct identifier namespaces.
A future automated reconciler needs namespace-aware identity checks before accepting any candidate source.
proposed: Require candidate_namespace, candidate_owner, semantic_role, created_at, immutable_locator, and predecessor_relation before a provenance-gap node can be resolved.
Reject suffix-only and fuzzy-name matches as namespace_collision unless corroborated by an immutable source assigning the exact continuity identifier.
superseded: Treating any search hit ending in -004, -005, or -006 as evidence for M-004, M-005, or M-006.
Using semantic similarity alone as identity proof.
unresolved: The authentic originating source, if any, for M-004, M-005, and M-006.
Whether those identifiers exist on an unobserved branch, another repository, private run log, or unpersisted automation output.

candidate_assessment.reason: Proof-machine benchmark namespace and mathematical semantics do not match continuity-mining namespace or role.
Proof-machine benchmark namespace and mathematical semantics do not match continuity-mining namespace or role.

coverage_limit: File Library search is relevance-ranked and non-exhaustive; this artifact proves only that the observed suffix matches are invalid candidates, not that no authentic M artifacts exist.
falsification_route: Produce an immutable source object that explicitly assigns the exact identifier M-004, M-005, or M-006 to a continuity artifact and predates the provenance-gap ledger.
privacy_boundary: Only opaque identifiers, repository metadata, file titles, and abstract semantic classifications are persisted. No private dialogue, personal events, health information, credentials, or identifying details are reproduced.
